mechanics.title: Limits
mechanics.description: Only detects structures (anything /locate can find). Features such as dungeons (monster rooms) and desert wells are not structures and cannot be detected.

editor_notes: Jar is built for 26.1; 26.2 compatibility assumed.
name: WITS (What Is This Structure?)
summary: Adds a /wits command that prints the registry names of all structures at the spot where you are standing. Installed on a server, it works for vanilla clients too.
